ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Apparel
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Cultivator clothes, textiles and armor for Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
Cloud cotton (a crop) and cloud cloth woven on a spirit loom, spirit silk, sect robes for outer disciples, inner disciples and elders in the colors of each sect (with Convergence: Factions), hanfu, bamboo hat, jade crown, spirit scale armor and runic battle robes with spirit grade. Spirit leather comes from butchering awakened spirit beasts.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation and Convergence: Resources. No electricity needed.
